title: Habanero sync problem
symptom: Treatments entered into Nightscout are not automatically synchronized with xDrip+. The sync can be forced by entering a treatment into xDrip+, then earlier Nightscout entered treatments are downloaded.
cause: A bug with Nightscout not correctly handling the Last-Modified-Since header and reporting there is no new data to download.
fix: Disabled the use of the Last-Modified-Since field as an interim measure until affected Nightscout versions are identified. The Oct 26th nightly should resolve the issue.
evidence_quote: I am pretty sure this is a bug with Nightscout not correctly handling the Last-Modified-Since header and reporting there is no new data to download. As an interim measure I have disabled the use of this field until we work out which NS versions are affected and then can handle it better. Please try the Oct 26th nightly which should resolve the issue.
